lemma contrast_eq {d v : ℝ} (he : ∀ i, (A.terms x d).E i 1 = 0) (hV : flags A.p.threshold V = ∅)
    (hv : (A.trial base x d v).eval 1 = H x 1) (hv' : (A.trial base x d v).eval V = H x V) :
    contrast H V x = (base x + d)*A.leg V + A.background V + A.add V x d := by
  rw [contrast,← hv, ← hv', A.trial_one base he,eval_trial, shape,gas_one _ _ hV,mul_one,← Real.exp_add,
    Real.log_exp,Real.log_exp]; ring

proof_context.conclusion: For unflagged `V` (so the forced factor `gas` is `1`) and a trial matching `H` at `1` and `V`, `contrast H V x = (base x + d)*leg V + background V + add V x d`, i.e. `f = 0` at that `d`.

have hall x (h : x∈l) : F x = G' x ∧ z x = Δ x := by
    have hleg : 0 < A.leg V := by
      have := (hP m).1.1; have := (B.a.budget m).threshold_pos; have := sites_pos (B.a.S.side m p)
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hv.2
    have hL : (A.trial (predictor B N Q) x (z x) (UVNext.CouplingReset.scalar (target Q) x)).eval = target Q x := (hM x h).1.ident
    have hr := (yield_shape g hm hb hx h' hv h (z x)).symm.trans (sub_eq_zero.mpr (A.contrast_eq ((records g hm hb hx h (z x)).1.regular.at_flat)
      hv.1 (congr_fun hL 1) (congr_fun hL V)).symm)
    have he : z x = Δ x := eq_of_sub_eq_zero (mul_eq_zero.mp hr |>.resolve_right hleg.ne')
    exact ⟨(congrArg (fun d => A.trial _ x d _) he).symm,he⟩

proof_context.conclusion: The residual vanishes at `z x`, and with `leg V > 0` this forces `z x = Averaging.delta`, the unique solution.
